name: What happens if hidden structural damage is uncovered during drywall demolition?

mainEntity.name: What happens if hidden structural damage is uncovered during drywall demolition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hidden damage is uncovered during demolition—such as rot inside wall cavities or damaged wiring—we document the issue with photographs and prepare an itemized supplement request for your carrier. Work on that specific section is paused until the insurance adjuster inspects or authorizes the added scope. This ensures that the newly discovered repairs are approved under your claim before materials are installed, protecting you from unexpected out-of-pocket costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: We document the hidden damage with photos and submit a supplement request to your insurance carrier for approval before repairing that area.
